arxiv-1911-01516.title: Latent Theme Dictionary Model for Finding Co-occurrent Patterns in Process Data
arxiv-1911-01516.creator: Guanhua Fang, Zhiliang Ying
arxiv-1911-01516.description: Abstract \justify Process data, which are temporally ordered sequences of categorical observations, are of recent interest due to its increasing abundance and the desire to extract useful information. A process is a collection of time-stamped events of different types, recording how an individual behaves in a given time period.

arxiv-2210-08949.title: Oscillatory cooperation prevalence emerges from misperception
arxiv-2210-08949.creator: Jing Zhang, Zhao Li, Jiqiang Zhang, Lin Ma, Guozhong Zheng, Li Chen
arxiv-2210-08949.description: Abstract Oscillatory behaviors are ubiquitous in nature and the human society. However, most previous works fail to reproduce them in the two-strategy game-theoretical models. Here we show that oscillatory behaviors naturally emerge if incomplete information is incorporated into the cooperation evolution of a non-Markov model.

arxiv-2308-08059.title: Topological Properties of Almost Abelian Lie Groups
arxiv-2308-08059.creator: Zhirayr Avetisyan, Oderico-Benjamin Buran, Andrew Paul, Lisa Reed
arxiv-2308-08059.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zhirayr Avetisyan, Oderico-Benjamin Buran, Andrew Paul, Lisa Reed. An almost Abelian Lie group is a non-Abelian Lie group with a codimension 1 Abelian subgroup. We show that all discrete subgroups of complex simply connected almost Abelian groups are finitely generated. The topology of connected almost Abelian Lie groups is studied by expressing each connected almost Abelian Lie group as a quotient of its universal covering group by a discrete normal subgroup.

arxiv-2407-15105.title: Weak convergence implies convergence in mean within GGC
arxiv-2407-15105.creator: Hasanjan Sayit
arxiv-2407-15105.description: Abstract We prove that weak convergence within generalized gamma convolution (GGC) distributions implies convergence in the mean value. We use this fact to show the robustness of the expected utility maximizing optimal portfolio under exponential utility function when return vectors are modelled by hyperbolic distributions. Keywords: GGC; Weak convergence; Expected utility; Mean-variance mixture models.

arxiv-2501-17931.title: X-Shooting ULLYSES: Massive Stars at Low Metallicity
arxiv-2501-17931.creator: J.M. Bestenlehner and Paul A. Crowther and C. Hawcroft and H. Sana and F. Tramper and J.S. Vink and S.A. Brands and A.A.C. Sander and the XShootU collaboration

Sander and the XShootU collaboration. The proximity and low dust extinction of the Magellanic Clouds provides an ideal environment for metal-poor massive stars to be studied in detail.

arxiv-2512-18264.title: Who Can See Through You? Adversarial Shielding Against VLM-Based Attribute Inference Attacks
arxiv-2512-18264.creator: Yucheng Fan, Jiawei Chen, Yu Tian, Zhaoxia Yin, [0.5em] East China Normal University, Shanghai, China
arxiv-2512-18264.description: Abstract As vision-language models (VLMs) become widely adopted, VLM-based attribute inference attacks have emerged as a serious privacy concern, enabling adversaries to infer private attributes from images shared on social media. This escalating threat calls for dedicated protection methods to safeguard user privacy.

europmc-pmc4777569.description: Background Periprosthetic joint infections (PJIs) are dreaded complications of total joint arthroplasties. The risk of developing PJIs is likely to be influenced by several patient factors such as sociodemographic characteristics, body mass index (BMI), and medical and surgical

pmc-11626132.title: Beyond a binary theorizing of prosociality
pmc-11626132.creator: Chen Shen, Zhixue He, Hao Guo, Shuyue Hu, Jun Tanimoto, Lei Shi, Petter Holme
pmc-11626132.description: SignificanceThe public goods game and its variant thereof are canonical stylized experiments that test the propensity to cooperate (or contribute to shared resources). They consistently show that humans are more cooperative than expected from economic theory, a fact that so far has had two explanations-prosociality as an innate human characteristic or a side effect of a learning process.

pmc-12385687.title: The Temporal and Spatial Distribution Patterns of Necrotic and Apoptotic Cells in and Around the Spinal Cord Injury Site †
pmc-12385687.creator: Selim Ayhan, Gokhan Bozkurt, Atilla Akbay, Mutlu Hayran, Hiroshi Ogawa, Wataru Yasui, Masato Tanaka, Ayse Ayhan, Andrea Angelini
pmc-12385687.description: Background: Acute spinal cord trauma management necessitates understanding the primary and secondary injury mechanisms at different timepoints. Objectives: To characterize the cell death process by examining the temporal and spatial distributions of necrosis and apoptosis in an experimental spinal cord injury model.

pmc-12391541.title: Behavioral interventions and respiratory virus incidence in a two-cohort study
pmc-12391541.creator: Behnam Nikparvar, Cara Exten, Nita Bharti
pmc-12391541.description: Behavioral interventions are a critical tool for managing novel and emerging pathogens. Examples include hand-washing, masking, or staying home when feeling ill. The dynamics of behavioral interventions have been difficult to measure and are poorly understood. This makes it difficult to assess their impact during outbreaks.

pmc-12471278.title: Protective Effects of Methanolic Extract of Micromeria frivaldszkyana (Degen) Velen Against Acetaminophen-Induced Liver Toxicity in Male Wistar Rats
pmc-12471278.creator: Elisaveta Apostolova, Kristina Stavrakeva, Vesela Kokova, Ivica Dimov, Mariya Choneva, Delyan Delev, Ilia Kostadinov, Ilia Bivolarski, Maria Koleva, Rumen Mladenov, Plamen Stoyanov, Anelia Bivolarska, Elena Dreassi, Demetrios Kouretas, Fotios Tekos
pmc-12471278.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Acetaminophen (APAP) overdose can result in potentially fatal acute liver failure, with free radical formation identified as a major mechanism of liver tissue damage. Micromeria frivaldszkyana (M. frivaldszkyana), a rare species endemic to Bulgaria, has demonstrated significant antioxidant activity. Male Wistar rats were treated orally for 7 days with saline; 250, 400, or 500 mg/kg of a water solution of dried methanolic extract of M. frivaldszkyana; 100 mg/kg rosmarinic acid (RA); or 125 mg/kg silymarin.

pmc-12711668.title: Fluorinated prodrug-engineered nano-remodeler relieves tumor hypoxia for dual-enhanced ferroptosis-immunotherapy
pmc-12711668.creator: Jin Lei, Xinxin Sun, Jianbin Shi, Pengfei Wang, Qingyue Guan, Zhixiao Zhang, Zhonggui He, Jin Sun, Peng Huang, Jing Lin, Cong Luo, Shenwu Zhang
pmc-12711668.description: SummaryFerroptosis is recognized as a form of regulated cell death characterized by iron-dependent lipid peroxidation and significant immunogenic properties. However, we observe that the hypoxic tumor microenvironment (TME) of solid tumors severely limits ferroptosis induction and antitumor immune responses, while simultaneously promoting programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression, thereby further compromising tumor immunotherapy.

pmc-12715725.title: Photodynamic therapy dosimetry: current status and the emerging challenge of immune stimulation
pmc-12715725.creator: Brian C. Wilson, Lothar Lilge, Robert A. Weersink, Layla Pires
pmc-12715725.description: .SignificanceAddressing the challenges of accurate dosimetry in photodynamic therapy has motivated some of the earliest work in tissue optics, which then enabled the broader development of biomedical optics. Inadequate use of dosimetry-informed treatments may contribute to heterogeneity in tumor response and variable clinical outcomes that need to be addressed.

pmc-12753976.title: A machine learning-based predictive model for stem cell therapy outcomes in plastic surgery
pmc-12753976.creator: Lingang Xu, Ying Lian, Zhen Song, Dongyi Zhang, Hongfeng Zhai
pmc-12753976.description: ObjectiveStem cell therapy has emerged as a promising approach in plastic surgery, yet its efficacy varies markedly among individuals and lacks reliable predictive assessment tools. This study aimed to construct and validate a predictive model for assessing the therapeutic efficacy of stem cell therapy in plastic surgery by identifying key influencing factors through clinical data analysis and machine learning.

pmc-12812527.title: Sarcoidosis misdiagnosed as pulmonary malignancy: a case report
pmc-12812527.creator: Houlu Zhang, Yubin Huang, Xiuyi Zhao, Daming Fan, Zhongxiang Xing, Xiaoming Sun, Liangming Zhu
pmc-12812527.description: Sarcoidosis is an idiopathic multisystem disease characterized by non-caseating granulomas primarily composed of epithelioid macrophages. The lungs and lymph nodes are the most commonly affected organs. Clinical manifestations of sarcoidosis vary widely, and its radiographic features often overlap with those of malignant tumors, especially pulmonary malignancy, increasing the diagnostic challenge.

pmc-13220741.title: On the Construct Validity of Performance-Based Emotion Recognition Tests: Correlations with Social-Emotional Functioning and Cognitive Skills
pmc-13220741.creator: Emalie Hendel, Marc Brysbaert
pmc-13220741.description: This study examined the construct validity of performance-based emotion recognition tests. We recruited 227 adults (30–60 years old) through Prolific to complete four emotion recognition tasks in addition to measures of self-reported empathy, crystallised intelligence, social confidence, loneliness/well-being, interest in people versus things, and reading enjoyment (all measured with at least two indicators).

pmc-13293268.title: Identification of diagnostic biomarkers for relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis in plasma by mass spectrometry-based proteomics
pmc-13293268.creator: Víctor M García-Silva, Eduardo Chicano-Galvez, María Isabel García-Sánchez, Ángela Peralbo-Molina, María Hernández-Valladares
pmc-13293268.description: In the absence of molecular biomarkers, the current diagnosis of multiple sclerosis is based on clinical assessment, neuroimaging, and detection of oligoclonal bands in cerebrospinal fluid. Early and rapid diagnosis using patient samples obtained by non-invasive methods would be a major advance in clinical management.

pmc-13312772.title: Gut microbiome modulates breast cancer risk in socially isolated mice
pmc-13312772.creator: Fabia de Oliveira Andrade, Christopher Staley, Lu Jin, Melike Ozgul-Onal, Maddie McDermott, Sercan Kenanoglu, Karla Andrade de Oliveira, Vivek Verma, Leena Hilakivi-Clarke
pmc-13312772.description: BackgroundBreast cancer risk and mortality are associated with disrupted gut microbiome functions which in turn can affect tumor immune responses. One source of disruption could be stress. Social isolation (SI) stress consistently increases breast cancer risk and mortality in preclinical models and women, but whether SI promotes mammary tumor growth by affecting gut microbiome has not been studied.

pmc-13315324.title: Integrative multi-omics analysis of growth plate regulation underlying body size in miniature pigs
pmc-13315324.creator: Nadia Khaveh, Jan Berghöfer, Brehm Ralph, René Buschow, Karsten Cirksena, Cord Drögemüller, Abeera Fatima, Gordon Grabert, Gisa Gerold, Alexander Grahofer, Ralf Herwig, Klaus Jung, Tim Kacprowski, Bai-Wei Lo, Roya Shiasi Sardoabi, Martin Vingron, Stefan Mundlos, Julia Metzger
pmc-13315324.description: Body size represents a complex phenotype driven by genetic variation and epigenetic regulation, with the molecular processes underlying this trait remaining a central challenge to disentangle. To elucidate these fundamental mechanisms, we apply a multi-omics approach that combines ROH-based selection mapping with growth plate epigenomics in pigs.

pmc-13476289.title: Exploring community-level gut health amidst COVID-19 pandemic: a proposed application of longitudinal wastewater surveillance
pmc-13476289.creator: Emma Lancaster, Yuehan Ai, Jiyoung Lee
pmc-13476289.description: Wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE) offers a unique, scalable method to monitor disease burden at a community level by capturing all individuals within a sewershed. While emerging evidence suggests that SARS-CoV-2 may influence the human gut microbiota, which is essential for health and disease outcomes, most microbiome studies remain limited to the individual scale.

pmc-13490223.title: In-hospital mortality and complications are increased in hematopoietic stem cell transplant recipients with myelodysplastic syndromes
pmc-13490223.creator: Aniket Vijay Rao, Aditya Sanjeevi, Daniel Jose Idoate-Domench, Diya Jayanth Kamdar, Suraj Palavilayil, Abdullah Orakzai, Himal Kharel, Muhammad Hammad Sharif, Sujay Prabath Dronamraju
pmc-13490223.description: Allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) remains the only curative therapy for patients with myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS). Despite evidence of comparable outcomes in selected older adults, disparities in HSCT utilization persist. This study analyzes trends, outcomes, and barriers such as age and insurance status associated with HSCT in MDS.

pmc-13575786.title: Stereotactic Hematoma Aspiration Versus Standard Treatment for Brainstem Hemorrhage—Updated Meta‐Analysis, Meta‐Regression, and Trial Sequential Analysis
pmc-13575786.creator: Paweł Łajczak, Ayesha Ayesha, Oguz K. Sahin, Anna Łajczak, Mable Pereira
pmc-13575786.description: IntroductionThe standard treatment of brainstem hemorrhage (BH) remains a controversial subject, and the optimal treatment strategy remains unclear. Stereotactic aspiration of a hematoma is one of the most used techniques in BH management. This review aims to update existing knowledge on the comparison of aspiration and standard treatments for BH.MethodsThis review updates a previous meta‐analysis on this subject.
